閾値の文.文: the default parameter setting in sharpcharts is 25 and the example below is based on 25 days.
because 12.5 days marks the exact middle, a reading of exactly 50 is impossible on a daily chart, though it is possible with other timeframes.
aroon is either below 50 (48) or above 50 (52) on daily charts.
a reading above 50 means a new high or low was recorded within the last 12 days.
a reading below 50 means a new high or low was recorded 13 or more days ago: (25-13)/25 x 100 = 48) .
the table below shows the range of values for 25-day aroon-up and 25-day aroon-down.
possible values for aroon-up and aroon-down interpreting aroon the aroon indicators fluctuate above/below a centerline (50) and are bound between 0 and 100.
at its most basic, the bulls have the edge when aroon-up is above 50 and aroon-down is below 50.
the bears have the edge when aroon-up is below 50 and aroon-down is above 50.
for example, a move to 100 in aroon-up combined with a decline below 30 in aroon-down shows upside strength.
the second stage is when aroon-up moves above 50 and aroon-down moves below 50.
the third stage is when aroon-up reaches 100 and aroon-down remains at relatively low levels.

強さ.文: developed by tushar chande in 1995, aroon is an indicator system that determines whether a stock is trending or not and how strong the trend is.
indicates trend strength and direction.

勢い.文: in this sense, the aroon indicators are quite different from typical momentum oscillators , which focus on price relative to time.
for example, chartists might use a momentum oscillator to identify oversold levels when 25-week aroon indicates that the long-term trend is up.

向き.文: the converse is true for a downtrend.
for an uptrend signal, the first stage occurs when aroon-up moves above aroon-down.
in a downtrend signal, the positions of the two lines are reversed: aroon-down breaks above aroon-up, breaks above 50, and reaches 100.

行き過ぎ.文: for example, chartists might use a momentum oscillator to identify oversold levels when 25-week aroon indicates that the long-term trend is up.

閾値の文.文: the default parameter setting in sharpcharts is 25 and the example below is based on 25 days.
because 12.5 days marks the exact middle, a reading of exactly 50 is impossible on a daily chart, though it is possible with other timeframes.
aroon is either below 50 (48) or above 50 (52) on daily charts.
a reading above 50 means a new high or low was recorded within the last 12 days.
a reading below 50 means a new high or low was recorded 13 or more days ago: (25-13)/25 x 100 = 48) .
the table below shows the range of values for 25-day aroon-up and 25-day aroon-down.
possible values for aroon-up and aroon-down interpreting aroon the aroon indicators fluctuate above/below a centerline (50) and are bound between 0 and 100.
at its most basic, the bulls have the edge when aroon-up is above 50 and aroon-down is below 50.
the bears have the edge when aroon-up is below 50 and aroon-down is above 50.
for example, a move to 100 in aroon-up combined with a decline below 30 in aroon-down shows upside strength.
the second stage is when aroon-up moves above 50 and aroon-down moves below 50.
the third stage is when aroon-up reaches 100 and aroon-down remains at relatively low levels.

強さ.文: developed by tushar chande in 1995, aroon is an indicator system that determines whether a stock is trending or not and how strong the trend is.
indicates trend strength and direction.
a positive or negative threshold can be used to define the strength of the trend.

勢い.文: in this sense, the aroon indicators are quite different from typical momentum oscillators , which focus on price relative to time.
for example, chartists might use a momentum oscillator to identify oversold levels when 25-week aroon indicates that the long-term trend is up.
as with all technical indicators, the aroon oscillator should be used in conjunction with other aspects of technical analysis, such as chart pattern analysis or momentum indicators .

向き.文: the converse is true for a downtrend.
for an uptrend signal, the first stage occurs when aroon-up moves above aroon-down.
in a downtrend signal, the positions of the two lines are reversed: aroon-down breaks above aroon-up, breaks above 50, and reaches 100.

行き過ぎ.文: for example, chartists might use a momentum oscillator to identify oversold levels when 25-week aroon indicates that the long-term trend is up.
this signal is not reversed until there is a move above +90, which is high enough to absorb most oversold bounces.

閾値の文.文: calculating cci the example below is based on a 20-period commodity channel index (cci) calculation.
when cci surges above +100, it reflects strong price action that can signal the start of an uptrend.
when cci plunges below -100, it reflects weak price action that can signal the start of a downtrend.
identifying new trends emerging as noted above, most cci movement occurs between -100 and +100.
although entry points will lag more, requiring a move above +100 for a bullish signal and a move below -100 for a bearish signal reduces whipsaws.
the chart below shows caterpillar (cat) with 20-day cci.
cci moved below -100 on january 22 (eight days later) to signal the start of an extended move.
the stock bottomed on february 8 and cci moved above +100 on february 17 (six days later) to signal the start of an extended advance.
extreme cci values can signal a change in trend cci triggered a bullish signal when cat surged above 60 in june.
±100 may work in a trading range, but more extreme levels are needed for other situations.
±200 is a much harder level to reach and more representative of a true extreme.
the chart below shows google (goog) with cci(20).

行き過ぎ.文: in this manner, cci can be used to identify overbought and oversold levels.
use the cci to identify overbought or oversold conditions that may foreshadow a mean reversion.
some traders may have considered the stock overbought and the reward-to-risk ratio unfavorable at these levels.

向き.文: when cci surges above +100, it reflects strong price action that can signal the start of an uptrend.
when cci plunges below -100, it reflects weak price action that can signal the start of a downtrend.
a strong uptrend can show numerous bearish divergences before a top actually materializes.

勢い.文: bullish and bearish divergences can be used to detect early momentum shifts and anticipate trend reversals.
overbought/oversold conditions identifying overbought and oversold levels can be tricky with the commodity channel index (cci), or any other momentum oscillator for that matter.
identifying bullish/bearish divergences divergences signal a potential reversal point because directional momentum does not confirm price.

値動きの幅.文: selection of overbought/oversold levels also depends on the volatility of the underlying security.
a longer timeframe, 40 versus 20, was used to reduce volatility.

強さ.文: before getting too excited about divergences as great reversal indicators, note that divergences can be misleading in a strong trend.

位置.文: a bearish divergence can be confirmed with a break below zero in cci or a support break on the price chart.
conversely, a bullish divergence can be confirmed with a break above zero in cci or a resistance break on the price chart.
a support break on the price chart and cci move into negative territory confirm this divergence a few days later.

出来高.文: another momentum oscillator would be redundant, but on balance volume (obv) or the accumulation distribution line can add value to cci signals.

def load_demand(bars_index, files: dict | None = None) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    """需給。元データが期間を覆っていない分は NaN のまま残し、被覆率を報告する。
    files はデータ検査（歩0）の番人がわざと壊したファイルを注入するためだけの引数＝通常は渡さない。"""
    import pathlib
    base = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    out, cov = {}, {}
    for name, (rel, tcol, vcol) in (files or _DEMAND_FILES).items():
        p = (base / rel).resolve()
        if not p.exists():
            cov[name] = "ファイルなし"; continue
        try:
            use = [tcol] + ([vcol] if vcol else ["taker_buy_base", "volume"])
            d = pd.read_csv(p, usecols=use, parse_dates=[tcol]).set_index(tcol).sort_index()
            d.index = d.index.tz_localize(None) if d.index.tz is not None else d.index
            s = (d[vcol] if vcol else (2 * d["taker_buy_base"] - d["volume"]).cumsum())
            s = s.reindex(bars_index, method="ffill")
            # 元データの終端より後は ffill で埋めない（実データが無い区間を持たない）
            s[bars_index > d.index.max()] = np.nan
            out[name] = pd.to_numeric(s, errors="coerce")
            cov[name] = f"{d.index.min().date()}〜{d.index.max().date()} / 対象期間の被覆 {s.notna().mean()*100:.1f}%"
        except Exception as e:
            cov[name] = f"読めず: {str(e)[:50]}"
    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=bars_index), cov

def load_demand(bars_index, files: dict | None = None) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    """需給。元データが期間を覆っていない分は NaN のまま残し、被覆率を報告する。
    files はデータ検査（歩0）の番人がわざと壊したファイルを注入するためだけの引数＝通常は渡さない。"""
    import pathlib
    base = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    out, cov = {}, {}
    for name, (rel, tcol, vcol) in (files or _DEMAND_FILES).items():
        p = (base / rel).resolve()
        if not p.exists():
            cov[name] = "ファイルなし"; continue
        try:
            use = [tcol] + ([vcol] if vcol else ["taker_buy_base", "volume"])
            d = pd.read_csv(p, usecols=use, parse_dates=[tcol]).set_index(tcol).sort_index()
            d.index = d.index.tz_localize(None) if d.index.tz is not None else d.index
            s = (d[vcol] if vcol else (2 * d["taker_buy_base"] - d["volume"]).cumsum())
            s = s.reindex(bars_index, method="ffill")
            # 元データの終端より後は ffill で埋めない（実データが無い区間を持たない）
            s[bars_index > d.index.max()] = np.nan
            out[name] = pd.to_numeric(s, errors="coerce")
            cov[name] = f"{d.index.min().date()}〜{d.index.max().date()} / 対象期間の被覆 {s.notna().mean()*100:.1f}%"
        except Exception as e:
            cov[name] = f"読めず: {str(e)[:50]}"
    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=bars_index), cov

既定.逐語: The default value is K=pmin(floor(sqrt(252*n)), n) with n=length(yuima)-1, following Lee and Mykland (2008) as well as Dumitru and Urga (2012).

勢い.文: on this page table of contents technical indicators & overlays technical indicators macd (moving average convergence/divergence) oscillator learn how the macd (moving average convergence/divergence) oscillator enhances technical analysis by measuring momentum and trend direction.

developed by gerald appel in the late seventies, the moving average convergence/divergence oscillator (macd), due to its simplicity and general effectiveness, is one of the most popular momentum indicators.
the macd turns two trend-following indicators, moving averages , into a momentum oscillator by subtracting the longer moving average from the shorter one.

行き過ぎ.文: because the macd is unbounded, it is not particularly useful for identifying overbought and oversold levels.
the macd is not particularly good for identifying overbought and oversold levels.
even though it is possible to identify levels that are historically overbought or oversold, the macd does not have any upper or lower limits to bind its movement.

勢い.文: on this page table of contents technical indicators & overlays technical indicators macd (moving average convergence/divergence) oscillator learn how the macd (moving average convergence/divergence) oscillator enhances technical analysis by measuring momentum and trend direction.

developed by gerald appel in the late seventies, the moving average convergence/divergence oscillator (macd), due to its simplicity and general effectiveness, is one of the most popular momentum indicators.
the macd turns two trend-following indicators, moving averages , into a momentum oscillator by subtracting the longer moving average from the shorter one.

行き過ぎ.文: because the macd is unbounded, it is not particularly useful for identifying overbought and oversold levels.
the macd is not particularly good for identifying overbought and oversold levels.
even though it is possible to identify levels that are historically overbought or oversold, the macd does not have any upper or lower limits to bind its movement.

値動きの幅.文: volatility in the underlying security can also increase the number of crossovers.

強さ.文: centerline crossovers can last a few days or a few months, depending on the strength of the trend.
the resulting signals worked well because strong trends emerged with these centerline crossovers.
in contrast to pulte homes, these signals would have resulted in numerous whipsaws because strong trends did not materialize after the crossovers.

the subsequent signal line crossover and support break in the macd were bearish.

_reg("MACD線%", "MACD線%({},{})", True, lambda d, f_, s_:
     (d.close.ewm(span=f_).mean() - d.close.ewm(span=s_).mean()) / d.close * 100)

typically, mfi above 80 is considered overbought and mfi below 20 is considered oversold.

conversely, mfi can become oversold (<20) and prices can continue lower when the downtrend is strong.
a move above 90 is truly overbought, and a move below 10 is truly oversold.
moves above 90 and below 10 are rare occurrences that suggest a price move is unsustainable.

出来高.文: on this page table of contents technical indicators & overlays technical indicators percentage volume oscillator (pvo) what is the percentage volume oscillator (pvo) the percentage volume oscillator (pvo) is a momentum oscillator for volume.
the pvo measures the difference between two volume-based moving averages as a percentage of the larger moving average.
the pvo is positive when the shorter volume ema is above the longer volume ema and negative when the shorter volume ema is below.

照合の関数・既知答え.流儀: 出どころの逐語『tol=clamp(K×ATR%_1h,0.15%,0.6%)』（設定 observe_config.json の sr_tol の説明に写してある）。1時間足の値は、その1時間足が閉じた時刻から使う。タッチは、その足の高値・安値で数える
照合の関数・既知答え.known:
def _known_sr_touch_atr1h(p):
    """S-Rタッチ1時間ATR の手計算の既知答え3件（2026-09-26・M2-E-4c）。

    ①下端に張り付く＝n＋12本を 100.1 で平ら（始値＝高値＝安値＝終値）・最後の1本だけ 100.0。
      1時間足の値動きの幅は0＝許容幅は下端 0.15%＝帯は 100±0.15。窓の n 本は全部 100.1＝全部 触れる → n
    ②上端に張り付く＝n＋12本を 終値 101.8・高値 104.8・安値 100.8、最後の1本だけ 100.0。
      1時間足の値動きの幅は 4.0（高値−安値）＝ATR% は 4÷101.8（約3.9%）。倍率 0.5 でも上端 0.6% に張り付く。
      帯は 100±0.6＝窓の安値 100.8 は 100.6 より上＝1本も触れない → 0
    ③1時間足と5分足で答えが割れる＝60時間ぶん、1時間ごとに 100.0 と 100.5 を交互に（1時間の中は平ら）、
      最後の1本だけ 100.0。1時間足の TR は2本目から 0.5＝ATR＝0.5×(1−(1−1/期間)^59)。
      最後に閉じた1時間足（60本目）は 100.5 で閉じる。許容幅＝倍率 × ATR ÷ 100.5 を上下限で挟む。
      窓の n 本の半分は 100.0（必ず触れる）・半分は 100.5（許容幅が 0.5% 以上のときだけ触れる）。
      ★5分足の ATR% で数えると、1時間の中は平らなので値動きの幅が小さく、許容幅は下端に張り付く
        ＝倍率 1.5 でも 100.5 に届かない＝この見本が「どの足の ATR で測ったか」を見分ける。
    """
    n, k, an = int(p[0]), float(p[1]), int(p[2])
    c1 = np.r_[np.full(n + 12, 100.1), 100.0]
    c2 = np.r_[np.full(n + 12, 101.8), 100.0]
    h2 = np.r_[np.full(n + 12, 104.8), 100.0]
    l2 = np.r_[np.full(n + 12, 100.8), 100.0]
    m = 60
    c3 = np.r_[np.repeat([100.0 + 0.5 * (j % 2) for j in range(m)], 12), 100.0]
    a3 = 0.5 * (1.0 - (1.0 - 1.0 / an) ** (m - 1))
    t3 = min(max(k * a3 / 100.5, 0.0015), 0.006)
    e3 = n / 2 + (n / 2 if 100.0 * t3 >= 0.5 else 0.0)
    return [(_mk(c1, o=c1, h=c1, l=c1), [(-1, float(n), 1e-9)]),
            (_mk(c2, o=c2, h=h2, l=l2), [(-1, 0.0, 1e-9)]),
            (_mk(c3, o=c3, h=c3, l=c3), [(-1, float(e3), 1e-9)])]

the stochastic oscillator is above 50 when the close is in the upper half of the range and below 50 when the close is in the lower half.
low readings (below 20) indicate that price is near its low for the given time period.
high readings (above 80) indicate that price is near its high for the given time period.
the ibm example above shows three 14-day ranges (yellow areas) with the closing price at the end of the period (red dotted) line.
traditional settings use 80 as the overbought threshold and 20 as the oversold threshold.
for example, if the 20-day stochastic oscillator is above 80 it indicates the underlying security is trading near the top of its 20-day high-low range.
a reading below 20 indicates the security is trading at the low end of its high-low range.
the chart below displays the full stochastic oscillator (20,5,5) in the panel below a price chart.
dips below 20 warn of oversold conditions that could foreshadow a bounce.
moves above 80 warn of overbought conditions that could foreshadow a decline.

def build_range_geometry(bars: pd.DataFrame, adaptive_k=None, h1_edge: str = "right") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """レンジ幾何列を作る（正本ロジック＝build_regime_gate_rg を e37._rg5_frames 経由で import 再利用・
    コピー禁止）。列＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF が正本（登録なしの列は足せない＝selftest）。
    adaptive_k=None（既定）＝RG-v5 固定束ね幅。エンジン E38 は RG-v6（e37.V25_K）を渡す＝流儀の違いは
    定義表に記載。全て当該バーまでの確定値（H2）＝検査8 の切り詰め再計算が機械確認する。"""
    import e37_scalp as e37                     # lazy
    d = bars[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].copy()
    d.insert(0, "ts", bars.index)
    d = d.reset_index(drop=True)
    # ★2026-10-20（工事 m2c15-band-s1-20261020・F-4・監査 CP60 の修正69）＝h1_edge＝帯の1時間足の区切り（right＝今・hour＝正時）
    _z, _up, _rng, res_lo, res_hi, sup_lo, sup_hi = e37._rg5_frames(d, adaptive_k, h1_edge=h1_edge)
    c = bars["close"].to_numpy(float)
    mid = (res_lo + sup_hi) / 2.0               # エンジン v11_mid と同式
    span = res_hi - mid
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        pos = np.where(np.isfinite(span) & (span > 0), (c - mid) / span, np.nan)
        wpct = np.where(np.isfinite(res_hi) & np.isfinite(sup_lo), (res_hi - sup_lo) / c * 100.0, np.nan)
        # ★2026-10-09（工事 m2c15-shape-structure-20261009・監査 CP60 の修正65）＝下半分の位置（下半分の幅＝mid − sup_lo で割る）。
        #   帯内位置% は下半分も上半分の幅で割る（今の版は残す）。定義表＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF の 下半分位置
        dn = mid - sup_lo
        low = np.where(np.isfinite(dn) & (dn > 0), (c - mid) / dn, np.nan)
    return pd.DataFrame({"res_hi": res_hi, "res_lo": res_lo, "sup_hi": sup_hi, "sup_lo": sup_lo,
                         "mid": mid, "W%": wpct, "帯内位置%": pos, "下半分位置": low}, index=bars.index)

強さ.文: the ribbon allows you to look at these relationships for multiple moving averages at once: if all the averages move in the same direction, this indicates a strong trend.

the ribbon's width-the distance between the moving average lines in the ribbon-can also provide information for traders: when all moving average lines are running in parallel (the lines are evenly spaced over time), this indicates a strong trend.
in addition, ribbon width expansions and contractions can indicate trend strength and possible trend changes.

向き.文: the longer- and shorter-term lines are all in agreement about the direction of the trend.
if all the moving average lines in the ribbon move upward, prices increase in all timeframes, and the security is likely in an uptrend.
if the shorter-term lines cross above the longer-term lines, this signals a new uptrend; a downtrend is indicated when shorter-term moving average lines cross below the longer-term ones.

def build_range_geometry(bars: pd.DataFrame, adaptive_k=None, h1_edge: str = "right") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """レンジ幾何列を作る（正本ロジック＝build_regime_gate_rg を e37._rg5_frames 経由で import 再利用・
    コピー禁止）。列＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF が正本（登録なしの列は足せない＝selftest）。
    adaptive_k=None（既定）＝RG-v5 固定束ね幅。エンジン E38 は RG-v6（e37.V25_K）を渡す＝流儀の違いは
    定義表に記載。全て当該バーまでの確定値（H2）＝検査8 の切り詰め再計算が機械確認する。"""
    import e37_scalp as e37                     # lazy
    d = bars[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].copy()
    d.insert(0, "ts", bars.index)
    d = d.reset_index(drop=True)
    # ★2026-10-20（工事 m2c15-band-s1-20261020・F-4・監査 CP60 の修正69）＝h1_edge＝帯の1時間足の区切り（right＝今・hour＝正時）
    _z, _up, _rng, res_lo, res_hi, sup_lo, sup_hi = e37._rg5_frames(d, adaptive_k, h1_edge=h1_edge)
    c = bars["close"].to_numpy(float)
    mid = (res_lo + sup_hi) / 2.0               # エンジン v11_mid と同式
    span = res_hi - mid
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        pos = np.where(np.isfinite(span) & (span > 0), (c - mid) / span, np.nan)
        wpct = np.where(np.isfinite(res_hi) & np.isfinite(sup_lo), (res_hi - sup_lo) / c * 100.0, np.nan)

the stochastic oscillator measures the close's level relative to the high-low range over a given period of time, say 20 days.

def build_range_geometry(bars: pd.DataFrame, adaptive_k=None, h1_edge: str = "right") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """レンジ幾何列を作る（正本ロジック＝build_regime_gate_rg を e37._rg5_frames 経由で import 再利用・
    コピー禁止）。列＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF が正本（登録なしの列は足せない＝selftest）。
    adaptive_k=None（既定）＝RG-v5 固定束ね幅。エンジン E38 は RG-v6（e37.V25_K）を渡す＝流儀の違いは
    定義表に記載。全て当該バーまでの確定値（H2）＝検査8 の切り詰め再計算が機械確認する。"""
    import e37_scalp as e37                     # lazy
    d = bars[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].copy()
    d.insert(0, "ts", bars.index)
    d = d.reset_index(drop=True)
    # ★2026-10-20（工事 m2c15-band-s1-20261020・F-4・監査 CP60 の修正69）＝h1_edge＝帯の1時間足の区切り（right＝今・hour＝正時）
    _z, _up, _rng, res_lo, res_hi, sup_lo, sup_hi = e37._rg5_frames(d, adaptive_k, h1_edge=h1_edge)
    c = bars["close"].to_numpy(float)
    mid = (res_lo + sup_hi) / 2.0               # エンジン v11_mid と同式
    span = res_hi - mid
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        pos = np.where(np.isfinite(span) & (span > 0), (c - mid) / span, np.nan)
        wpct = np.where(np.isfinite(res_hi) & np.isfinite(sup_lo), (res_hi - sup_lo) / c * 100.0, np.nan)
        # ★2026-10-09（工事 m2c15-shape-structure-20261009・監査 CP60 の修正65）＝下半分の位置（下半分の幅＝mid − sup_lo で割る）。
        #   帯内位置% は下半分も上半分の幅で割る（今の版は残す）。定義表＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF の 下半分位置
        dn = mid - sup_lo
        low = np.where(np.isfinite(dn) & (dn > 0), (c - mid) / dn, np.nan)
    return pd.DataFrame({"res_hi": res_hi, "res_lo": res_lo, "sup_hi": sup_hi, "sup_lo": sup_lo,
                         "mid": mid, "W%": wpct, "帯内位置%": pos, "下半分位置": low}, index=bars.index)

def build_range_geometry(bars: pd.DataFrame, adaptive_k=None, h1_edge: str = "right") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """レンジ幾何列を作る（正本ロジック＝build_regime_gate_rg を e37._rg5_frames 経由で import 再利用・
    コピー禁止）。列＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF が正本（登録なしの列は足せない＝selftest）。
    adaptive_k=None（既定）＝RG-v5 固定束ね幅。エンジン E38 は RG-v6（e37.V25_K）を渡す＝流儀の違いは
    定義表に記載。全て当該バーまでの確定値（H2）＝検査8 の切り詰め再計算が機械確認する。"""
    import e37_scalp as e37                     # lazy
    d = bars[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].copy()
    d.insert(0, "ts", bars.index)
    d = d.reset_index(drop=True)
    # ★2026-10-20（工事 m2c15-band-s1-20261020・F-4・監査 CP60 の修正69）＝h1_edge＝帯の1時間足の区切り（right＝今・hour＝正時）
    _z, _up, _rng, res_lo, res_hi, sup_lo, sup_hi = e37._rg5_frames(d, adaptive_k, h1_edge=h1_edge)
    c = bars["close"].to_numpy(float)
    mid = (res_lo + sup_hi) / 2.0               # エンジン v11_mid と同式
    span = res_hi - mid
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        pos = np.where(np.isfinite(span) & (span > 0), (c - mid) / span, np.nan)
        wpct = np.where(np.isfinite(res_hi) & np.isfinite(sup_lo), (res_hi - sup_lo) / c * 100.0, np.nan)
        # ★2026-10-09（工事 m2c15-shape-structure-20261009・監査 CP60 の修正65）＝下半分の位置（下半分の幅＝mid − sup_lo で割る）。
        #   帯内位置% は下半分も上半分の幅で割る（今の版は残す）。定義表＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF の 下半分位置
        dn = mid - sup_lo
        low = np.where(np.isfinite(dn) & (dn > 0), (c - mid) / dn, np.nan)
    return pd.DataFrame({"res_hi": res_hi, "res_lo": res_lo, "sup_hi": sup_hi, "sup_lo": sup_lo,
                         "mid": mid, "W%": wpct, "帯内位置%": pos, "下半分位置": low}, index=bars.index)

def build_range_geometry(bars: pd.DataFrame, adaptive_k=None, h1_edge: str = "right") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """レンジ幾何列を作る（正本ロジック＝build_regime_gate_rg を e37._rg5_frames 経由で import 再利用・
    コピー禁止）。列＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF が正本（登録なしの列は足せない＝selftest）。
    adaptive_k=None（既定）＝RG-v5 固定束ね幅。エンジン E38 は RG-v6（e37.V25_K）を渡す＝流儀の違いは
    定義表に記載。全て当該バーまでの確定値（H2）＝検査8 の切り詰め再計算が機械確認する。"""
    import e37_scalp as e37                     # lazy
    d = bars[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].copy()
    d.insert(0, "ts", bars.index)
    d = d.reset_index(drop=True)
    # ★2026-10-20（工事 m2c15-band-s1-20261020・F-4・監査 CP60 の修正69）＝h1_edge＝帯の1時間足の区切り（right＝今・hour＝正時）
    _z, _up, _rng, res_lo, res_hi, sup_lo, sup_hi = e37._rg5_frames(d, adaptive_k, h1_edge=h1_edge)
    c = bars["close"].to_numpy(float)
    mid = (res_lo + sup_hi) / 2.0               # エンジン v11_mid と同式
    span = res_hi - mid
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        pos = np.where(np.isfinite(span) & (span > 0), (c - mid) / span, np.nan)
        wpct = np.where(np.isfinite(res_hi) & np.isfinite(sup_lo), (res_hi - sup_lo) / c * 100.0, np.nan)
        # ★2026-10-09（工事 m2c15-shape-structure-20261009・監査 CP60 の修正65）＝下半分の位置（下半分の幅＝mid − sup_lo で割る）。
        #   帯内位置% は下半分も上半分の幅で割る（今の版は残す）。定義表＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF の 下半分位置
        dn = mid - sup_lo
        low = np.where(np.isfinite(dn) & (dn > 0), (c - mid) / dn, np.nan)
    return pd.DataFrame({"res_hi": res_hi, "res_lo": res_lo, "sup_hi": sup_hi, "sup_lo": sup_lo,
                         "mid": mid, "W%": wpct, "帯内位置%": pos, "下半分位置": low}, index=bars.index)

def load_demand(bars_index, files: dict | None = None) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    """需給。元データが期間を覆っていない分は NaN のまま残し、被覆率を報告する。
    files はデータ検査（歩0）の番人がわざと壊したファイルを注入するためだけの引数＝通常は渡さない。"""
    import pathlib
    base = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    out, cov = {}, {}
    for name, (rel, tcol, vcol) in (files or _DEMAND_FILES).items():
        p = (base / rel).resolve()
        if not p.exists():
            cov[name] = "ファイルなし"; continue
        try:
            use = [tcol] + ([vcol] if vcol else ["taker_buy_base", "volume"])
            d = pd.read_csv(p, usecols=use, parse_dates=[tcol]).set_index(tcol).sort_index()
            d.index = d.index.tz_localize(None) if d.index.tz is not None else d.index
            s = (d[vcol] if vcol else (2 * d["taker_buy_base"] - d["volume"]).cumsum())
            s = s.reindex(bars_index, method="ffill")
            # 元データの終端より後は ffill で埋めない（実データが無い区間を持たない）
            s[bars_index > d.index.max()] = np.nan
            out[name] = pd.to_numeric(s, errors="coerce")
            cov[name] = f"{d.index.min().date()}〜{d.index.max().date()} / 対象期間の被覆 {s.notna().mean()*100:.1f}%"
        except Exception as e:
            cov[name] = f"読めず: {str(e)[:50]}"
    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=bars_index), cov

def build_range_geometry(bars: pd.DataFrame, adaptive_k=None, h1_edge: str = "right") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """レンジ幾何列を作る（正本ロジック＝build_regime_gate_rg を e37._rg5_frames 経由で import 再利用・
    コピー禁止）。列＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF が正本（登録なしの列は足せない＝selftest）。
    adaptive_k=None（既定）＝RG-v5 固定束ね幅。エンジン E38 は RG-v6（e37.V25_K）を渡す＝流儀の違いは
    定義表に記載。全て当該バーまでの確定値（H2）＝検査8 の切り詰め再計算が機械確認する。"""
    import e37_scalp as e37                     # lazy
    d = bars[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].copy()
    d.insert(0, "ts", bars.index)
    d = d.reset_index(drop=True)
    # ★2026-10-20（工事 m2c15-band-s1-20261020・F-4・監査 CP60 の修正69）＝h1_edge＝帯の1時間足の区切り（right＝今・hour＝正時）
    _z, _up, _rng, res_lo, res_hi, sup_lo, sup_hi = e37._rg5_frames(d, adaptive_k, h1_edge=h1_edge)
    c = bars["close"].to_numpy(float)
    mid = (res_lo + sup_hi) / 2.0               # エンジン v11_mid と同式
    span = res_hi - mid
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        pos = np.where(np.isfinite(span) & (span > 0), (c - mid) / span, np.nan)
        wpct = np.where(np.isfinite(res_hi) & np.isfinite(sup_lo), (res_hi - sup_lo) / c * 100.0, np.nan)
        # ★2026-10-09（工事 m2c15-shape-structure-20261009・監査 CP60 の修正65）＝下半分の位置（下半分の幅＝mid − sup_lo で割る）。
        #   帯内位置% は下半分も上半分の幅で割る（今の版は残す）。定義表＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF の 下半分位置
        dn = mid - sup_lo
        low = np.where(np.isfinite(dn) & (dn > 0), (c - mid) / dn, np.nan)
    return pd.DataFrame({"res_hi": res_hi, "res_lo": res_lo, "sup_hi": sup_hi, "sup_lo": sup_lo,
                         "mid": mid, "W%": wpct, "帯内位置%": pos, "下半分位置": low}, index=bars.index)

閾値の文.文: the default parameter setting in sharpcharts is 25 and the example below is based on 25 days.
because 12.5 days marks the exact middle, a reading of exactly 50 is impossible on a daily chart, though it is possible with other timeframes.
aroon is either below 50 (48) or above 50 (52) on daily charts.
a reading above 50 means a new high or low was recorded within the last 12 days.
a reading below 50 means a new high or low was recorded 13 or more days ago: (25-13)/25 x 100 = 48) .
the table below shows the range of values for 25-day aroon-up and 25-day aroon-down.
possible values for aroon-up and aroon-down interpreting aroon the aroon indicators fluctuate above/below a centerline (50) and are bound between 0 and 100.
at its most basic, the bulls have the edge when aroon-up is above 50 and aroon-down is below 50.
the bears have the edge when aroon-up is below 50 and aroon-down is above 50.
for example, a move to 100 in aroon-up combined with a decline below 30 in aroon-down shows upside strength.
the second stage is when aroon-up moves above 50 and aroon-down moves below 50.
the third stage is when aroon-up reaches 100 and aroon-down remains at relatively low levels.

強さ.文: developed by tushar chande in 1995, aroon is an indicator system that determines whether a stock is trending or not and how strong the trend is.

勢い.文: in this sense, the aroon indicators are quite different from typical momentum oscillators , which focus on price relative to time.
for example, chartists might use a momentum oscillator to identify oversold levels when 25-week aroon indicates that the long-term trend is up.

向き.文: the converse is true for a downtrend.
for an uptrend signal, the first stage occurs when aroon-up moves above aroon-down.
in a downtrend signal, the positions of the two lines are reversed: aroon-down breaks above aroon-up, breaks above 50, and reaches 100.

def build_range_geometry(bars: pd.DataFrame, adaptive_k=None, h1_edge: str = "right") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """レンジ幾何列を作る（正本ロジック＝build_regime_gate_rg を e37._rg5_frames 経由で import 再利用・
    コピー禁止）。列＝indicator_reference_diag.RANGE_GEO_REF が正本（登録なしの列は足せない＝selftest）。
    adaptive_k=None（既定）＝RG-v5 固定束ね幅。エンジン E38 は RG-v6（e37.V25_K）を渡す＝流儀の違いは
    定義表に記載。全て当該バーまでの確定値（H2）＝検査8 の切り詰め再計算が機械確認する。"""
    import e37_scalp as e37                     # lazy
    d = bars[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].copy()
    d.insert(0, "ts", bars.index)
    d = d.reset_index(drop=True)
    # ★2026-10-20（工事 m2c15-band-s1-20261020・F-4・監査 CP60 の修正69）＝h1_edge＝帯の1時間足の区切り（right＝今・hour＝正時）
    _z, _up, _rng, res_lo, res_hi, sup_lo, sup_hi = e37._rg5_frames(d, adaptive_k, h1_edge=h1_edge)
    c = bars["close"].to_numpy(float)
    mid = (res_lo + sup_hi) / 2.0               # エンジン v11_mid と同式
    span = res_hi - mid
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        pos = np.where(np.isfinite(span) & (span > 0), (c - mid) / span, np.nan)
        wpct = np.where(np.isfinite(res_hi) & np.isfinite(sup_lo), (res_hi - sup_lo) / c * 100.0, np.nan)

閾値の文.文: the default parameter setting in sharpcharts is 25 and the example below is based on 25 days.
because 12.5 days marks the exact middle, a reading of exactly 50 is impossible on a daily chart, though it is possible with other timeframes.
aroon is either below 50 (48) or above 50 (52) on daily charts.
a reading above 50 means a new high or low was recorded within the last 12 days.
a reading below 50 means a new high or low was recorded 13 or more days ago: (25-13)/25 x 100 = 48) .
the table below shows the range of values for 25-day aroon-up and 25-day aroon-down.
possible values for aroon-up and aroon-down interpreting aroon the aroon indicators fluctuate above/below a centerline (50) and are bound between 0 and 100.
at its most basic, the bulls have the edge when aroon-up is above 50 and aroon-down is below 50.
the bears have the edge when aroon-up is below 50 and aroon-down is above 50.
for example, a move to 100 in aroon-up combined with a decline below 30 in aroon-down shows upside strength.
the second stage is when aroon-up moves above 50 and aroon-down moves below 50.
the third stage is when aroon-up reaches 100 and aroon-down remains at relatively low levels.

強さ.文: developed by tushar chande in 1995, aroon is an indicator system that determines whether a stock is trending or not and how strong the trend is.

勢い.文: in this sense, the aroon indicators are quite different from typical momentum oscillators , which focus on price relative to time.
for example, chartists might use a momentum oscillator to identify oversold levels when 25-week aroon indicates that the long-term trend is up.

向き.文: the converse is true for a downtrend.
for an uptrend signal, the first stage occurs when aroon-up moves above aroon-down.
in a downtrend signal, the positions of the two lines are reversed: aroon-down breaks above aroon-up, breaks above 50, and reaches 100.

位置.文: pivot points are significant levels on a chart that traders and investors can use to determine directional movement and potential support/resistance levels.

a move above the second resistance level would show strength but also indicate an overbought situation that could lead to a pullback.
